info.name: CyCognito API V1 Reference Assets Issues API

params.name: count
params.description: Defines the number of results to be retrieved. Defaults to 10 with a max limit of 1000.

params.name: advanced-search
params.description: Allows you to input raw CyQL in order to query assets, issues, or organizations. See our Advanced Search documentation for more details.

params.name: offset
params.description: Sets the starting index for result retrieval, influenced by the `count` parameter. By default, `offset` is 0. Example: `offset` 3 with `count` 25 fetches results from index 75 to 99.

params.name: q
params.description: Specifies a search term for conducting a keyword-based search and retrieving data that matches your query.

params.name: fields
params.description: A comma-separated list specifying the desired entity properties to appear in the response. For more information, view the response example and schema.

params.name: sort-by
params.description: Specifies the field by which the results should be sorted.

params.name: sort-order
params.description: Sorts the specified field in ascending or descending order.

items.docs: Retrieve a list of issues based on given filter criteria. If you are comparing search results with the CyCognito app, note that Predefined Filters are not applied to data queried via the API by default.

params.name: issue_instance_id
params.description: Unique identifier for a specific issue occurrence on an asset. This is the `id` value from the response, excluding the `issue/` prefix.

items.docs: Obtain details of a specific issue using its identifier.

params.name: issue_instance_id
params.description: Unique identifier for a specific issue occurrence on an asset. This is the `id` value from the response, excluding the `issue/` prefix.

items.docs:
Adjust the specified issue's investigation status:
- **Investigated** – The issue has been investigated.
- **Investigating** – The issue is currently undergoing investigation by someone in your team.
- **Uninvestigated** – The issue has not been investigated yet.
Allows you to add comments to multiple issues identified by their unique IDs. The comments are appended to the existing comment log and do not replace any existing content.

params.name: action
params.description:
Choose an action to apply to the tags on the specified entities: 
 * **add** – Apply new tags in addition to the existing tags on the specified entities. 
 * **remove** – Clears only the indicated tags from the specified entities. 
 * **replace** – Replaces *all* of the current tags on *all* of the specified entities with the indicated tags. 
 * **remove-all** – Clears *all* of the existing tags from the specified entities.

items.docs: Add or remove custom tags from specified issues.
Move issues to an archived state, distinguishing them from open and resolved issues.

Snooze issues for a specified duration, hiding them from your open issues list until the snooze period expires. This enables automated lifecycle control from external workflows while maintaining accurate attack surface metrics.
